subject.title: [Feature]: Talk/Voice tab — agent/session switching + per-agent TTS voice

question: Should Talk/Voice follow the Chat-selected session, expose its own agent/session picker, or use another companion-app routing model for multi-agent voice conversations?
rationale: Current code proves the remaining gap, but the right UX and routing contract is a maintainer product decision before a repair PR should touch Talk routing or cross-platform companion-app behavior.

options.title: Own Talk/Voice Picker
options.body: Add a first-class Talk/Voice selector that routes native and realtime Talk turns to the chosen agent/session without adding a new `talk.voiceId` config path.

options.title: Follow Chat Selection
options.body: Make Talk/Voice reuse the current Chat session selection, reducing UI surface but coupling voice routing to Chat state.

options.title: Defer Voice Routing
options.body: Keep per-agent TTS as the delivered half and leave multi-agent Talk routing for a broader companion-app design pass.

recommendation.title: Own Talk/Voice Picker
recommendation.body: Add a first-class Talk/Voice selector that routes native and realtime Talk turns to the chosen agent/session without adding a new `talk.voiceId` config path.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored/commented on the per-agent TTS resolution and show up in the current Talk/Chat history, making them the best available routing owner for the product choice.
